statement: Service shall support at least 46.2 effective trips/hour at the declared 42 trip/hour surge plus 10% reserve
90th percentile rider pickup wait shall not exceed 12 minutes in the event-day scenario
At least 95% of defined eligible request locations shall receive an accessible feasible trip offer
measure: geographic and temporal accessible offer coverage
scenario: defined service geography and peak day

statement: Annual operating expenditure estimate shall be no more than 1.20 million USD at baseline scope
Concept acquisition cost estimate shall be no more than 3.0 million USD
Nominal dispatch command chain shall meet 500ms end-to-end timing; degraded timing requires a documented fallback
When digital booking fails, an alternate booking path shall serve accessible users
A concept readiness claim shall cite evidence current for the declared configuration
